import ast
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
r = Path('/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics')
qa = r / 'docs/papers204_208_sequence/qa'
new = qa / 'p210_b_strict_preparation/run_pair.py'
old = qa / 'p210_a_strict_preparation/run_pair.py'
helper = qa / 'p210_checkpoint_stage_revision_01/process_support.py'
b = r / 'docs/papers204_208_sequence/reviews/p210_b'
def pin(p):
    data = p.read_bytes()
    return {'sha256': sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(data)}
def functions(p):
    tree = ast.parse(p.read_bytes())
    return tree, {n.name: ast.dump(n, include_attributes=False) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
tree, fn = functions(new)
_, fo = functions(old)
_, fh = functions(helper)
changed = {'select_role', 'preflight', 'check_original_output', 'child', 'command', 'seal', 'run'}
added = {'group_members', 'settle_group'}
assert set(fn) == set(fo) | added
assert added.isdisjoint(fo)
assert {name for name in fo if fo[name] != fn[name]} == changed
assert all(fn[name] == fh[name] for name in added)
assert len(set(fo) - changed) == 18
compile(tree, str(new), 'exec')
spec = next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'SPECS' for t in n.targets))
assert set(spec) == {'p210_b'}
spec = spec['p210_b']
assert spec['payloads'] == 407
assert spec['manifest_sha'] == '81b5f97a6b25d6f9e82db87001da1a54668c01268038694d4b8a3b61006b02c3'
assert pin(b / 'SHA256SUMS')['sha256'] == spec['manifest_sha']
rows = {}
manifest_bytes = (b / 'SHA256SUMS').read_bytes()
assert manifest_bytes.endswith(b'\n')
for line in manifest_bytes.decode().split('\n')[:-1]:
    match = re.fullmatch(r'([0-9a-f]{64})  (.+)', line)
    assert match
    digest, name = match.groups()
    p = Path(name)
    assert not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts and name != 'SHA256SUMS' and name not in rows
    rows[name] = digest
actual_files = set()
for p in b.rglob('*'):
    assert not p.is_symlink()
    if p.is_file():
        actual_files.add(p.relative_to(b).as_posix())
assert len(rows) == 407 and actual_files == set(rows) | {'SHA256SUMS'}
names = ['SHA256SUMS', 'verify.py', 'verify.committed.py', 'PARAMETERS.json', 'CANONICAL.json',
         'COMPLETE_SOURCE_COMMITMENT.actual.json', 'PRE_COMPARISON_PROOF_CODE_COMMITMENT.actual.json',
         'INDEPENDENCE_COMMITMENT.md', 'INPUT_PINS.sha256', 'REPORT.md', 'FINDINGS.json', 'REPLAY_KEYS.json',
         'produce01/commands/run_1/stdout']
paths = [b / name for name in names] + [old, helper, r / 'docs/research_state/WORKFLOW.md', r / 'docs/papers204_208_sequence/ARTIFACT_CONTRACT.md']
inputs = {str(p): pin(p) for p in paths}
for name in names:
    if name != 'SHA256SUMS':
        assert inputs[str(b / name)]['sha256'] == rows[name]
for name, key in [('verify.py', 'verifier_sha'), ('verify.committed.py', 'verifier_sha'), ('PARAMETERS.json', 'parameters_sha'), ('CANONICAL.json', 'canonical_sha')]:
    assert inputs[str(b / name)]['sha256'] == spec[key]
assert inputs[str(b / 'CANONICAL.json')]['bytes'] == spec['canonical_bytes'] == 6475161
assert inputs[str(b / 'produce01/commands/run_1/stdout')] == inputs[str(b / 'CANONICAL.json')]
scientific_tree = ast.parse((b / 'verify.py').read_bytes())
scientific_imports = sorted({alias.name for n in ast.walk(scientific_tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Import) for alias in n.names} | {n.module for n in ast.walk(scientific_tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom)})
assert scientific_imports == ['collections', 'functools', 'json', 'pathlib', 'sys']
compile(scientific_tree, str(b / 'verify.py'), 'exec')
data = json.loads((b / 'CANONICAL.json').read_bytes())
assert data['checks'] == spec['checks'] == 51129 and data['states'] == 4095
assert [row['mass'] for row in data['census']] == list(range(1, 13))
assert sum(len(row['states']) for row in data['census']) == 4095
assert sum(len(row['triangular_codes']) for row in data['census']) == 265
committed = json.loads((b / 'COMPLETE_SOURCE_COMMITMENT.actual.json').read_bytes())
assert committed['author_A_code_or_canonical_semantics_read'] is False
assert committed['files']['verify.py'] == spec['verifier_sha']
assert committed['files']['PARAMETERS.json'] == spec['parameters_sha']
comparison = json.loads((b / 'PRE_COMPARISON_PROOF_CODE_COMMITMENT.actual.json').read_bytes())
assert comparison['author_A_verifier_or_canonical_body_semantics_read'] is False
assert comparison['pins']['CANONICAL.json'] == spec['canonical_sha']
findings = json.loads((b / 'FINDINGS.json').read_bytes())
assert findings['current_open_counts'] == {'Critical': 0, 'Major': 0, 'Minor': 0}
assert findings['accepted_delta'] is False and findings['root_response_reviewed'] is False
assert 'PASS_NARROW_INITIAL_PENDING_ROOT_RESPONSE' in (b / 'REPORT.md').read_text()
target = qa / 'root_replays/p210_b_strict_pair_01'
assert not os.path.lexists(target)
assert {p.name for p in new.parent.iterdir()} == {'run_pair.py', 'README.md'}
result = {'status': 'PASS_STATIC_ONLY_NOT_EXECUTED', 'observed_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'scope': 'AST comparison and compile-only; sealed B manifest syntax/inventory and selected original byte pins; original canonical parsed as data only. No harness import/preflight/run, scientific execution, native comparison pair or runtime inventory.',
          'inputs': inputs, 'source': pin(new), 'source_lines': len(new.read_bytes().splitlines()),
          'unchanged_functions': sorted(set(fo) - changed), 'changed_functions': sorted(changed),
          'added_helpers_ast_identical_to_accepted_source': sorted(added),
          'scientific_imports': scientific_imports, 'initial_B_payloads': len(rows), 'initial_B_physical_files': len(actual_files),
          'B_manifest_payload_hashes_checked_here': len(names) - 1,
          'whole_B_payload_hash_closure_deferred_to_root_preflight': True,
          'original_canonical_metadata': {'checks': data['checks'], 'states': data['states'], 'masses': [row['mass'] for row in data['census']], 'triangular_objects': 265, 'same_sha256_and_size_as_actual_original_producer_stdout': True},
          'expected_native_commands': 10, 'expected_output_payloads': 59,
          'target_absent': str(target), 'fresh_scientific_executions': 0, 'preparation_preflight_executed': False,
          'owner_status': 'OWNER_AMBER', 'external_status': 'HOLD_EXTERNAL'}
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
